messages:
nina: heads-up: SampleKit publish failed in CI. regen-diff shows a type rename and sample app auth test flaked. blocking the release.

oscar: can you paste the CI snippet?

nina: ci-bot shows: nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed, nodejs-sdk/test auth-retry suite failed. snippet below:

ci-bot: [build 5310] nodejs-sdk/regendiff-check failed

nina: ```diff
--- a/src/client.ts
+++ b/src/client.ts
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@
-  authRetry?: boolean;
+  authRetries?: number;
```

lee: that looks like the new typegen changed the name and default. did someone bump typegen/version in the monorepo?

oscar: devx-bot: which packages depend on @redwood/typegen@^3.2.0?

devx-bot: @redwood/samplekit, @redwood/samplekit-node, @redwood/devtools depend on @redwood/typegen@3.2.0 (candidate).

lee: sample apps assume authRetry is boolean and exercise exponential backoff. new version switched to retries:number + linear backoff default. tests assert behavior, so they fail.

nina: i ran generator locally on macos (arm) and got the new shape; CI uses linux-x64 and had older pinned version so regen-diff tripped.

oscar: two issues: (1) nondeterministic ordering across platforms -> regen diffs, (2) breaking semantics in a minor bump. changelog didn't surface the semantic change.

lee: quick options: revert the typegen bump, pin typegen to 3.1.x in SDKs, or accept new API and bump SDK semver + changelog.

oscar: prefer pin + patch release to unblock. we'll follow with a proper minor that migrates API + documents behavioral change.

nina: i've opened a hotfix branch samplekit/pin-typegen-3.1 and pushed package.json lock update. running CI now.

ci-bot: rebuild queued: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5311 :rocket:

oscar: medium-term we should add a pre-publish lint that detects renamed fields with keywords (retry, backoff, auth) and warns. also add a test harness that runs typegen on linux-x64 in CI to avoid platform diffs.

lee: agree. i'll draft a small CLI check that diffs previous published types and heuristically flags potentially breaking renames (name changes, type changes for fields with retry/auth/backoff in name).

oscar: file an issue and link the hotfix PR. make sure we include repro steps for arm vs x64 nondet diffs.

nina: done: created devex issue #421 "typegen: detect rename/semantics for auth/retry and run linux-x64 regen in CI" with logs and repro. PR: https://github.com/redwood/samplekit/pull/413

lee: if CI green we'll merge and rollout patch. then schedule the minor update to migrate to authRetries:number and add migration guide in SDK docs.

oscar: also update release checklist: run local typegen on linux-x64 (ci container) and verify changelog mentions any semantic changes even in minor bumps.

nina: thanks — will follow up with a short playbook note and a sample migration snippet to help customers. :thumbsup:
